Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    varIsApprover,
    Navigate(Screen_WeeklyApprovals, ScreenTransition.Fade),
    Notify("No timesheets for approval.", NotificationType.Error)
)

If(
    varIsAdmin,
    Navigate(Screen_Settings, ScreenTransition.Fade),
    Notify("Settings are for admins only", NotificationType.Error)
)

If(
    CountRows(colMissingWeeks) = 0,
    "All timesheets up to date",
    Text(CountRows(colMissingWeeks)) & " week(s) not submitted"
)
Text(varPendingApprovalWeeks) & " timesheet week(s) waiting for approval"

Launch(
    "mailto:staffclock@stconnect.ca" &
    "?subject=" & EncodeUrl("StaffClock Support Request") &
    "&body=" & EncodeUrl("Hi StaffClock team," & Char(10) & Char(10) & "I need help with...")
)

Launch(
    "mailto:staffclock@stconnect.ca" &
    "?subject=" & EncodeUrl("StaffClock Support Request") &
    "&body=" & EncodeUrl("Hi StaffClock team," & Char(10) & Char(10) & "I need help with...")
)
